title: Runtime isolation and resilient recovery
summary: Hardens the operations platform so database stalls do not freeze Discord interactions or hide incidents, and repairs reviewed request cards and interrupted deliveries safely.
changes: Isolated the native Turso driver in a bounded worker process to protect Discord heartbeats and interactions
Added bounded database queue waits, cancellation-safe connection ownership, and explicit degraded-write health
Removed database waits before review modals and restored persistent buttons before Discord login
Made error delivery independent of storage, added component and modal error handling, and displayed repeated incident counts without double-counting retries
Added a memory-only recovery dashboard and readiness checks for event-loop, storage, and background-task health
Hardened startup deadlines, reconnect initialization, missing-task recovery, supervisor independence, and default retention loading
Added interrupted outbox recovery, delivery receipts, recent-send deduplication, and durable disabling of reviewed request buttons
Automatically refreshed expired pending level validation snapshots and clarified stale evidence messages
Fixed reviewed-wave request repair and made deployment smoke-test failures visible during database outages
Expanded outage regression tests and updated the private architecture manual and incident diagnosis
